context.body: A public contest moves from silence to fire, confession, and execution.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD answers Elijah’s prayer with fire that consumes offering, wood, stones, dust, and water.
observations.label: God answers Elijah by fire: action

observations.body: The people waver, watch the failed Baal appeal, fall down, confess, and seize the prophets.
observations.label: God answers Elijah by fire: response

observations.body: How long will you limp? · answer by fire · the LORD is God
observations.label: Words in 1 Kings 18:20–40

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 18:20–40 as land, judges, and kings evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The scene presents decisive divine response alongside human violence that must not be hidden in retelling.
payload.title: God answers Elijah by fire
